finding: CF-AN-INTRINSIC-FINISH-IS-NOT-AN-ADDRESS (Drew ruling 20, 2026-09-08; completing PR #2012). Refractor is INTRINSIC to the 2022 Topps Chrome Image Variation -- BCP's own heading note is "All Gimmicks are Refractors" -- so `:image-variation-refractor:` and `:image-variation:` are ONE card at two addresses. Measured 2026-09-09 over 2022 Topps Chrome baseball: the Refractor-suffixed address is occupied ONLY by ingest-auto-seed rows (26 ungraded + 23 graded), while the Image Variation SP (20) and SSP (5) checklist rows from beckett-scraped-2026-09-01 sit on the bare address. #2012 fixed the normalizer to unify the two TITLE spellings and unified them onto the SEEDED address, so holding 2b62a93f re-derived onto an ingest-auto-seed row and was reported checklist-backed by a row minted from our own sales. The normalizer fix in this PR sends the leading-finish spelling to the checklist address; this list retires the seeded twins it leaves behind. SCOPE IS sport=baseball AND year=2022 AND setKey=topps-chrome ONLY: catalog-wide the same address string carries 1,183 `checklist` and 95 checklistcenter rows in OTHER products, and not one is touched. A seeded row whose number has NO SP/SSP row is PARKED, never retired: #221 (the holding's own card), #112, #114, #223, #25, #96 and #4 are not in Beckett's Tier 1/Tier 2 lists, and #113's SP row names Jarren Duran where the seed names Hunter Greene.
